question: After every generic Shatter and tested Shatter-relic family is removed, does exact current-main contain one distinct authored Shatter-aftermath relation that can support a separate natural-capacity screen?
scientificBasis: The exact _shatter_enemy function is a finite branch surface. Adamant suppresses the Shatter event; every realised Shatter emits the same base vulnerable and Ember outputs; Prism Charm and Bell of Endings are tested relic branches; and positive Smolder invokes the existing target-preserving transfer before enemy death. Only the last branch couples reward-pool Smolder production to Dusk-only Shatter without adding a payoff, carrier or state.

frontierScope.included: Every conditional and unconditional branch executed directly by exact current-main _shatter_enemy, plus the shared _jump_smolder function and exact natural poison-card routes.
excluded: pre-Shatter Facet production, threshold or target topology
generic Shatter count, vulnerable, Ember or action-economy payoff
Shatterer's Crown, Prism Charm or Bell of Endings variation
death-triggered Smolder transfer as an independent family
poison magnitude, card subset, target policy or acquisition tuning
payoff, carrier, content mutation, telemetry, ML, RL or optimiser
trace, cache, outcome or policy support
frontierScope.claimBoundary: This source-only audit may select at most one exact existing relation for a separately preregistered zero-new-row upper-capacity screen. It cannot establish realised transfer, causal complementarity, package admission or product authority.

aftermathBranchPartition.definition: The first attempted pane break on an unspent Adamant enemy increments facet_max, emits adamantHold and returns before a SHATTER event or aftermath.
aftermathBranchPartition.reason: This is an opponent-authored suppression state and produces no realised Shatter package mediator.

aftermathBranchPartition.definition: Every realised Shatter records the Shatter, staggers the enemy, applies two Vulnerable and grants two Embers.
aftermathBranchPartition.reason: Another reward on all Shatters or their universal vulnerable/Ember output reopens the closed generic Shatter and Shatter-tempo families.

aftermathBranchPartition.definition: With Prism Charm and no earlier proc in the fight, the Shatter grants two additional Embers and consumes the fight-scoped proc.
aftermathBranchPartition.reason: Prism Charm is an exact tested #524 Shatter target recorded as excluded by the current-main Dusk source screen.

aftermathBranchPartition.definition: If the shattered enemy carries positive Smolder and another enemy remains alive, exact current-main removes that Smolder and invokes _jump_smolder before death; the seeded destination receives the same amount and SMOLDER_JUMP records from, to and n.
aftermathBranchPartition.reason: This is an existing cross-mechanic state transfer, not a generic Shatter payoff, relic effect, threshold, same-target repeat or enemy-death reward.

aftermathBranchPartition.definition: With Bell of Endings, the Shatter deals four damage to every other living enemy after the base and Smolder branches.
aftermathBranchPartition.reason: Bell of Endings is an exact tested #524 Shatter target recorded as excluded by the current-main Dusk source screen.

selectedRelation.name: Shatter-triggered Smolder transfer
selectedRelation.exactPredicate: A realised Dusk Shatter finds positive poison on the shattered enemy while at least one other enemy is alive, then invokes the existing _jump_smolder function from the Shatter branch.

mechanisticInteractions.sameCardRoute: venomStrike and annihilate resolve their poison effects before play_card applies pending Facet chips, so an unblocked Dusk Attack can author poison and then Shatter within the same card resolution. This is a source possibility, not a support claim.
mechanisticInteractions.stagedRoute: toxicMist applies Smolder without Attack chips and therefore requires a later Shatter-producing card.
mechanisticInteractions.deathAlias: _on_enemy_death also invokes _jump_smolder. A later factor or trace must distinguish the Shatter call site and leave death transfer unchanged; this audit does not count generic death jumps as candidate activation.
mechanisticInteractions.rng: _jump_smolder uses the run RNG only when at least one destination exists. Reproducibility remains seeded; a future null factor must preserve the call path exactly and no causal claim may ignore post-mediator RNG divergence.
mechanisticInteractions.anchors: Scoreline and Afterimage remain separate fixed activation anchors. Neither payoff is present, varied or estimated here.

decisionRules.success: The exact aftermath partition is complete, prior evidence closes every realised-Shatter branch except Smolder transfer, the natural route inventory matches source and all immutable identities pass within 30 seconds without reading support.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze only Shatter-triggered Smolder transfer for one separately preregistered zero-new-row upper-capacity screen on exact current-default Dusk rows.
